Each finished paper is one page, built from [the page template](_template/index.qmd). That template is rendered so the patterns can be clicked through. A directory whose name starts with `_` is not a paper. Every other `papers/<name>/index.qmd` is.

Quarto skips underscore paths in automatic listings, so this page lists the template by hand. The five papers below are listed by hand too. `paper-order` in this page's front matter is the build order. The table follows that field from row 1 to row 5.

## First papers

These are the rebuilds to write first. The brief for each one is already in its directory. None of them has `index.qmd` yet, so the page is coming soon. The directory link opens that folder. It is not a link to a missing page. When a rebuild merges, change Coming soon to a link to that page, and leave the row where it is.
